translations.web: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
translations.bsb: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
translations.kjv: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
translations.asv: And as for my sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
